tom_tat: Peak-aboo. In case you missed it, one of 2025's biggest hits — Peak — is heading onto PS5 at last. As it turns out, this isn't the only so-called "friendslop" game bound for Sony's console in the near future. Friendslop is a term coined to describe a particular brand of online co-op games, with Peak being a great example. Others might include things like Content Warning , or even Escape the Backrooms — basically any co-op game with a lower budget that's built for chaos. Read the full article on pushsquare.com
